claim: Exhaustive classification of the original level-three cusp-end object into two distinct actual identity and S ends by integral matrix congruences and exact representative coverage.

obligations.name: Objects and coefficients
obligations.required_input: Original integral group, original finite cusp-end object and exact residues.
obligations.constructed_input: Actual SL2(Z), Gamma1(3), ZMod3 and End3.
obligations.justification: The source is the original integral SL2 action and original Gamma1(3) orbit quotient. Congruence tests use ZMod3; upper triangular coordinate changes remain actual integral matrices. The final object is literally FiniteCuspEnds318.End 3, not a newly declared two-point set.

obligations.name: Required hypotheses
obligations.required_input: Determinant one and the two nonzero F3 residues; no freeness or negative identity membership.
obligations.justification: The determinant-one equation is used to infer matching nonzero diagonal residues when the lower-left residue is0. The two nonzero F3 residues are checked directly. The central-sign action identity is an original modular-action theorem; no false membership of -I in Gamma1(3) or freeness assertion is made.

obligations.name: Index coverage
obligations.required_input: All rotations and all selected finite representatives.
obligations.justification: Every g in SL2(Z) is classified. Both possibilities for its lower-left residue are exhausted, and the nonzero case covers both signs. A separate equality binds the all-rotation range to the existing finite selected representative image, so no missing representative is concealed.

obligations.name: Maps and directions
obligations.required_input: Correct matrix conjugation and high-region intersection direction.
obligations.constructed_input: S T^n g^-1 with lower-left d-nc; actual Gamma1 left action and upper triangular height preservation.
obligations.justification: The S-case comparison matrix is S T^n g^-1, and its lower-left entry is d-nc. Left action by this matrix sends g*tau to S*(T^n*tau). Upper triangular transformations preserve height, giving an actual intersection of the two high regions. The existing all-level theorem identifies their neighborhoods from this intersection. The same proof handles a central negative sign because it acts trivially on H.

obligations.name: Downstream identity
obligations.required_input: Identity with the actual old finite end consumer.
obligations.constructed_input: Original rotations_cover plus quotient_smul, exact endRegions pair and exhaustive original End3 values.
obligations.justification: rotations_cover gives g=gamma*r in the correct left coset direction. The exact quotient_smul equality then proves the selected and all-rotation end sets equal. endRegions_eq_pair, infinityEnd, zeroEnd, ends_distinct and end_exhaustion all refer to the original end object.

obligations.name: Local conditions and normalization
obligations.required_input: Exact region height and distinct actual ends.
obligations.constructed_input: Height2 with required1<=2 and predecessor widths1,3.
obligations.justification: All high regions use height2; the intersection theorem is supplied its required bounds1<=2. Every upper triangular comparison preserves the same height. The width1/width3 distinction used for noncoincidence is the earlier actual stabilizer-width computation, not a new source ramification or T-coordinate assumption.

obligations.name: Arithmetic and exceptional scope
obligations.required_input: No use of high-level freeness or unrelated arithmetic hypotheses.
obligations.constructed_input: Separate direct level3 matrix argument, covering elliptic interior without modification.
obligations.justification: This is an exact level-three end classification. Elliptic stabilizers inside H do not obstruct the argument and are not removed. No higher-level freeness theorem is instantiated at3. No scheme normalization, PEL structure, integral ramification or field-degree statement is involved or inferred.

obligations.name: History and dependencies
obligations.required_input: Changed route requires distinct review; preserve predecessors and historical dispositions.
obligations.constructed_input: Four copied predecessor files unchanged and new classification source bound independently.
obligations.justification: Four predecessor sources and their reviewed application remain unchanged. The new matrix and representative-coverage consumer needs a distinct bounded review. Existing high-level compactification source limitations remain recorded. No earlier historical argument is declared missing and no manuscript/audit verdict is rewritten.

obligations.name: Verification and acceptance
obligations.required_input: Strict exact sources and private-inclusive recursive audit.
obligations.constructed_input: Five-source fresh replay and59 declarations, original baseline pins.
obligations.justification: The receipt binds all five sources, final strict replay logs, private-inclusive recursive audit and original baseline source pins. Exact copied predecessors are rechecked. Compiler success is not a substitute for non-author source/application acceptance or a whole-proof audit.
